data: Permanent and temporary care-home stays require different Pension Credit household and component checks. DMG 78088 is under the heading Claimants who have no partner (including self-funders): all severe-disability-addition conditions still apply, including actual qualifying-benefit receipt. One partner entering permanently and both partners living permanently in a home require the separate DMG 77128–77130 household branches. Funding alone does not determine the whole credit.
